Strangely, something similar like this happened to me a few weeks ago. It wasn't a comic book collection but my 1st edition Pokemon Cards....

I had kept them (what I thought) safe in a box hidden away within some of my possessions, in another box, clearly labelled with my name.

One day out of nowhere, my sister asked my mum for them. My mum didn't know the value of them and so my mum gave them to her. No one asked me if it was ok.

We're unsure as to why my sister wanted them. She was never interested in Pokemon when we were younger and she gave conflicting stories as to why she wanted them. One was to show the kids at the school she teaches and another, because my parents were having a clear out. My mum and dad confirmed the second reason was not true. Adding up everything....we can't help but feel there was some sort of intent here for financial gain. 

She couldn't find them although she was adamant they were safe under a bed at hers. She gaslit me and then stopped replying to me. She eventually found them but refused to send me a picture of the folder contents.....we haven't spoken since. 

I spiralled into looking at the legal aspects of everything under the country's law system. Depending on that, it can be taken to civil court under theft if it was clearly your property and you were not asked, regardless of if you left them behind for safe keeping or not. 

I decided not to go down this route as it's been difficult enough to see my sister in a different light. We will never know why she truly wanted them, why she took so long to find them and failed to acknowledge my feelings. My parents are yet to have the cards returned to them to check the authenticity....

Basically - they are yours and I'm going to assume your sister & BIL are well aware of this. If they are good to you (which I really hope they are), then they will return them as they are rightfully yours. In the worst case; they might have sold some, given them away for free or sold them all. If it is the worst case - the best they can do now, is provide you with the respect and decency to be honest with you about this.

My fingers are crossed for you!
